description: Claude Code installs a marketplace directory source directly, so this host's bundle is the plugin itself. bundle_root is '.' because marketplace.template.json declares source './'; a host that nests its plugin inside the bundle sets this to that subdirectory. roles/ and hosts/ are NOT development surface, although they look like it: the bundle ships validate_roles.py, render_agents.py and root_preflight.py, and all three read those manifests - along with adapters/<host>/agent-interface.json, which is what decides whether a delegating role may be built here at all. layout.json ships too, because render_agents reads it to find where the plugin manifest landed - inside the bundle the template is gone and only its placed copy remains. Only THIS host's capability manifest and its interface FILE ship: the other hosts name bundled_dir paths a Claude Code install has no reason to carry, and the rest of this adapter directory is the mechanics the bundle already carries in their installed positions - shipping the directory whole would put a second copy of the hooks and both manifests inside the bundle. Since ADR 0001 step 3 the hooks and the two manifests live here rather than at the repository root, so dist/claude-code/ is the only loadable plugin - the repository root is no longer one. That is the point: what gets reviewed and what gets installed are the same tree, and the byte gate proves it.
